title: Skeletal Trinity in Orb
description: Three melting skeletal figures stand inside a large transparent sphere, their ribcages and skulls visible as dark viscous liquid drips from their bodies. The orb contains a swirling vortex of red, magenta and cyan, with bright electric blue lightning arcing across the interior and exterior against a black cosmic background.
prompt: Three melting skeletal figures with glowing eyes stand inside a massive transparent sphere, their bodies dripping with dark viscous liquid that pools at the bottom. Inside the orb swirls a hypnotic vortex of red, magenta and cyan energy. Bright electric blue lightning bolts crackle throughout the sphere and across the black background. Dark cosmic horror atmosphere with dripping textures and intense glowing highlights.
